name: Klaus-Dieter Richter
bio:
Klaus-Dieter Richter's journey in motorsport began not on the track, but in the engineering workshops of his father's automotive repair business. Immersed in the world of engines and mechanics from a young age, Klaus-Dieter developed a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and performance. His early fascination led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in motorsport technology. After graduating, he joined a small Formula 3 team as a junior engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and relentless pursuit of perfection. 

Klaus-Dieter's approach to team management is characterized by a data-driven, analytical mindset. He believes in empowering his team members, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation and efficiency are valued above all else. His meticulous attention to detail and strategic planning have consistently led to improved performance and championship contention, making him a highly sought-after team principal in the motorsport world. He joined Reiza Racing Academy to help build a championship-winning team from the ground up.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build, Klaus-Dieter often sports a focused expression behind his thin-rimmed glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas, regardless of the situation.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of German coffee beans, believing it enhances team performance.
